description: Defines the WebSocketInflater class for decompressing DEFLATE compressed data, including buffer management and inflation methods.

classes.name: WebSocketInflater
classes.description: A class for inflating (decompressing) data compressed with DEFLATE, managing input/output buffers, and providing decompressed data.

classes.name: WebSocketInflater::OutputBuffer
classes.description: A ring buffer class for holding output data during inflation.

classes.name: WebSocketInflater::InputQueue
classes.description: A queue managing input buffers for the inflater.

methods.name: WebSocketInflater(size_t, size_t)
methods.description: Constructor with specified input queue and output buffer capacities.

methods.name: Initialize
methods.description: Initializes the inflater with a specified window bits parameter.

methods.name: AddBytes
methods.description: Adds compressed data bytes to the inflater.

methods.name: Finish
methods.description: Flushes the input data to complete inflation.

methods.name: GetOutput
methods.description: Retrieves decompressed output data of specified size.

methods.name: CurrentOutputSize
methods.description: Returns the size of current decompressed output.
